note: Hand-written particle practice: word + particle collocations, grouped by particle.

uses.label: Topic
uses.note: Marks what the sentence is about.
uses.example: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。

uses.label: Contrast
uses.note: Sets one thing against another, often with negatives.
uses.example: [肉|にく]は[食|た]べますが、[魚|さかな]は[食|た]べません。

uses.label: XはYが
uses.note: Topic + a feature of it marked by が.
uses.example: [象|ぞう]は[鼻|はな]が[長|なが]いです。

uses.label: After other particles
uses.note: には / では add a topic or contrast to a place or target.
uses.example: [学校|がっこう]では[日本語|にほんご]を[話|はな]します。

cards.en: I am a student.
cards.why: 私 is the topic you are describing: topic → は.

cards.en: Mr. Tanaka is an office worker.
cards.why: The person being introduced is the topic of an AはBです sentence.

cards.en: It's hot today, isn't it?
cards.why: 今日 is the topic being commented on; time words take は, not に, here.

cards.en: This book is interesting.
cards.why: The thing you describe with an adjective is the topic: は.

cards.en: Sunday is a day off.
cards.why: 日曜日 is what the sentence is about: AはBです.

cards.en: Where is the toilet?
cards.why: In 〜はどこですか the thing you are looking for is the topic.

cards.en: My hobby is reading.
cards.why: 趣味 is the topic being defined: AはBです.

cards.en: My father is a doctor.
cards.why: The family member you talk about is the topic: は.

cards.en: Elephants have long trunks.
cards.why: In XはYが, X (象) is the topic and Y (鼻) is the feature.

cards.before: [肉|にく]は[食|た]べますが、[魚|さかな]
cards.en: I eat meat, but I don't eat fish.
cards.why: Two things are contrasted, so both take は.

cards.before: [東京|とうきょう]には[行|い]きましたが、[大阪|おおさか]に
cards.en: I went to Tokyo, but I didn't go to Osaka.
cards.why: は attaches after に to contrast 大阪 with 東京 (には).

cards.before: [兄|あに]は[背|せ]が[高|たか]いですが、[私|わたし]
cards.en: My older brother is tall, but I am short.
cards.why: 私 is contrasted with 兄, so it takes contrastive は.

cards.after: [日本語|にほんご]を[話|はな]します。
cards.en: At school, I speak Japanese.
cards.why: は can follow で to make the place a topic (では).

groups.title: Subject; object of likes, skills and wants; existence

uses.label: Subject of events
uses.note: Marks who or what does or is something, especially natural events.
uses.example: [雨|あめ]が[降|ふ]っています。

uses.label: Likes, skills, understanding
uses.note: 好き・上手・分かる・できる・ほしい take が for their object.
uses.example: [私|わたし]は[犬|いぬ]が[好|す]きです。

uses.label: Existence and having
uses.note: What exists or what you have with ある / いる.
uses.example: [時間|じかん]がありません。

uses.label: Question-word subject
uses.note: だれ・何 as subject always take が, never は.
uses.example: だれが[来|き]ましたか。

cards.en: It is raining.
cards.why: 雨 is the subject of the natural event 降る: が.

cards.before: [私|わたし]は[日本語|にほんご]
cards.en: I understand Japanese.
cards.why: 分かる takes its object with が, not を.

cards.en: I like dogs.
cards.why: 好き is an adjective, so the thing liked is marked with が.

cards.en: I don't have time today.
cards.why: With ある / ない, the thing that exists (or doesn't) takes が.

cards.before: [机|つくえ]の[上|うえ]に[猫|ねこ]
cards.en: There is a cat on the desk.
cards.why: The living thing that exists with いる takes が.

cards.en: I want a new computer.
cards.why: ほしい is an adjective, so the thing wanted takes が.

cards.en: My older sister is good at cooking.
cards.why: 上手 / 下手 mark the skill with が.

cards.before: [私|わたし]は[車|くるま]の[運転|うんてん]
cards.en: I can drive a car.
cards.why: できる marks the ability with が.

cards.en: Who came?
cards.why: A question word as subject takes が; だれは is not possible.

cards.en: I have a headache.
cards.why: The body part that hurts is the subject of 痛い: が.

cards.en: The wind is strong today.
cards.why: 風 is the subject described by 強い: が.

cards.before: [駅|えき]の[近|ちか]くに[銀行|ぎんこう]
cards.en: There is a bank near the station.
cards.why: A non-living thing that exists with ある takes が.

cards.before: [私|わたし]は[兄弟|きょうだい]
cards.en: I have two siblings.
cards.why: Having family uses いる, and the people take が.

cards.en: The lights suddenly went out.
cards.why: 消える is intransitive, so its subject takes が (消す would take を).

groups.title: Object of an action; path you move through; place you leave

uses.label: Direct object
uses.note: Marks what the verb acts on.
uses.example: [水|みず]を[飲|の]みます。

uses.label: Path / route
uses.note: The place you move through or along.
uses.example: [道|みち]を[渡|わた]ります。

uses.label: Place you leave
uses.note: The place or vehicle you get out of or leave.
uses.example: [部屋|へや]を[出|で]ます。

cards.before: [毎朝|まいあさ]、[新聞|しんぶん]
cards.en: I read the newspaper every morning.
cards.why: 新聞 is what you read: object → を.

cards.before: [公園|こうえん]で[写真|しゃしん]
cards.en: I took photos in the park.
cards.why: 写真 is the object of 撮る: 写真を撮る.

cards.en: I caught a cold yesterday.
cards.why: The set phrase is 風邪をひく: the cold is the object.

cards.en: Please be careful crossing the road.
cards.why: 渡る marks what you cross with を.

cards.en: I left the room at eight.
cards.why: 出る marks the place you leave with を.

cards.en: I get off the bus at the next station.
cards.why: 降りる marks the vehicle you get off with を (乗る uses に).

cards.before: [毎朝|まいあさ]、[公園|こうえん]
cards.en: I take a walk through the park every morning.
cards.why: 散歩する marks the area you walk through with を.

cards.after: [右|みぎ]に[曲|ま]がってください。
cards.en: Please turn right at the next corner.
cards.why: 曲がる marks the corner you go around with を.

cards.before: [去年|きょねん]、[大学|だいがく]
cards.en: I graduated from university last year.
cards.why: 卒業する marks the school you leave with を.

cards.en: I called my mother.
cards.why: The phrase is 電話をかける; the person gets に.

cards.en: I forgot my homework.
cards.why: 忘れる is transitive: the thing forgotten takes を.

cards.en: Birds are flying in the sky.
cards.why: 飛ぶ marks the space moved through with を.

cards.en: I take a shower in the morning.
cards.why: The set phrase is シャワーを浴びる.

cards.before: [熱|ねつ]があったので、[会社|かいしゃ]
cards.en: I had a fever, so I took the day off work.
cards.why: 休む marks the work or school you skip with を.

groups.title: Target of an action; time; where something is; destination and result

uses.label: Target
uses.note: The person or thing an action is aimed at: 乗る・会う・聞く・あげる.
uses.example: [友達|ともだち]に[会|あ]います。

uses.label: Time point
uses.note: A specific time, day or date.
uses.example: [七時|しちじ]に[起|お]きます。

uses.label: Where something is
uses.note: Location of existence with ある・いる・住む.
uses.example: [大阪|おおさか]に[住|す]んでいます。

uses.label: Destination, result, purpose
uses.note: Where you go in, what you become, why you go.
uses.example: [医者|いしゃ]になりたいです。

cards.en: I get on the train at the station.
cards.why: 乗る marks the vehicle you board with に (降りる uses を).

cards.before: [明日|あした]、[私|わたし]は[友達|ともだち]
cards.en: I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.
cards.why: 会う marks the person you meet with に, not を.

cards.before: [分|わ]からないことは[先生|せんせい]
cards.en: I ask the teacher about things I don't understand.
cards.why: 聞く (ask) marks the person asked with に.

cards.en: I get up at seven every morning.
cards.why: A clock time takes に.

cards.en: I go home at six.
cards.why: 帰る marks the place you return to with に.

cards.en: My older brother lives in Osaka.
cards.why: 住む marks where you live with に, not で.

cards.before: [将来|しょうらい]、[医者|いしゃ]
cards.en: I want to become a doctor in the future.
cards.why: なる marks the result with に: 医者になる.

cards.before: ノックしてから、[部屋|へや]
cards.en: Please knock before you enter the room.
cards.why: 入る marks the place you go into with に (出る uses を).

cards.after: [牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう]があります。
cards.en: There is milk in the fridge.
cards.why: Where something exists with ある takes に, not で.

cards.en: I gave my little brother a book.
cards.why: The receiver of あげる takes に.

cards.before: [毎朝|まいあさ][電車|でんしゃ]で[会社|かいしゃ]
cards.en: I commute to the office by train every morning.
cards.why: 通う marks the place you regularly go to with に.

cards.en: I'm going back to my country during summer vacation.
cards.why: A named period like 夏休み takes に as a time point.

cards.en: Please have a seat.
cards.why: 座る marks the seat with に.

cards.before: デパートへ[買|か]い[物|もの]
cards.en: I'm going to the department store to shop.
cards.why: Purpose of going: activity noun + に + 行く.

groups.title: Direction of movement; へ + の before a noun

uses.label: Direction
uses.note: The direction or place you head toward.
uses.example: [来年|らいねん]、[日本|にほん]へ[行|い]きます。

uses.label: へ + の + noun
uses.note: 〜への makes a 'to X' phrase before a noun; には cannot do this.
uses.example: [母|はは]への[手紙|てがみ]を[書|か]きました。

uses.label: へ + は
uses.note: へは makes the destination a topic or contrast.
uses.example: [空港|くうこう]へはバスで[行|い]きます。

cards.en: I'm going to Japan next year.
cards.why: へ marks the direction you travel toward with 行く.

cards.en: I'm going back to my country next month.
cards.why: 帰る takes the direction of return with へ.

cards.en: Everyone, please come this way.
cards.why: こちら is the direction of movement: こちらへ.

cards.after: の[手紙|てがみ]を[書|か]きました。
cards.en: I wrote a letter to my mother.
cards.why: Before の you need への; にの is not possible.

cards.after: の[旅行|りょこう]は[楽|たの]しかったです。
cards.en: The trip to Japan was fun.
cards.why: A 'trip to X' before a noun is Xへの旅行.

cards.en: The ship is heading east.
cards.why: A compass direction of movement takes へ.

cards.after: の[質問|しつもん]はありますか。
cards.en: Do you have any questions for the teacher?
cards.why: 'Questions to X' before a noun is Xへの質問.

cards.en: To the airport, I go by bus.
cards.why: へは makes the destination the topic.

cards.en: I'm on my way to school now.
cards.why: 向かう marks the place you head toward with へ.

cards.en: Where are you going this weekend?
cards.why: どこ as a destination of 行く takes へ.

cards.en: Please turn right at the next corner.
cards.why: The direction you turn (右・左) takes へ.

cards.after: のお[土産|みやげ]を[買|か]いました。
cards.en: I bought souvenirs for my family.
cards.why: 'Souvenirs for X' before a noun is Xへのお土産.

cards.before: [去年|きょねん]、[北海道|ほっかいどう]
cards.en: I moved to Hokkaido last year.
cards.why: 引っ越す marks the new place you move toward with へ.

groups.title: Place of an action; means and tools; cause; scope

uses.label: Place of action
uses.note: Where an action happens (not where something exists).
uses.example: [公園|こうえん]で[遊|あそ]びます。

uses.label: Means, tool, language, material
uses.note: How you do it: vehicle, tool, language, material.
uses.example: バスで[学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます。

uses.label: Cause
uses.note: Reason with nouns like illness, accidents, weather.
uses.example: [病気|びょうき]で[学校|がっこう]を[休|やす]みました。

uses.label: Scope / total
uses.note: Range or total: 全部で, 日本で一番, 一人で.
uses.example: [全部|ぜんぶ]で[千円|せんえん]です。

cards.before: [子供|こども]たちは[公園|こうえん]
cards.en: The children are playing in the park.
cards.why: 遊ぶ is an action, so its place takes で.

cards.after: [友達|ともだち]を[待|ま]っています。
cards.en: I'm waiting for a friend at the station.
cards.why: 待つ is an action, so where you wait takes で.

cards.en: I study at the library.
cards.why: The place where you study (an action) takes で.

cards.before: [私|わたし]は[毎日|まいにち]バス
cards.after: [学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます。
cards.en: I go to school by bus every day.
cards.why: A means of transport takes で.

cards.after: ご[飯|はん]を[食|た]べます。
cards.en: I eat rice with chopsticks.
cards.why: A tool you use takes で.

cards.en: I write letters in Japanese.
cards.why: The language you use takes で.

cards.after: [学校|がっこう]を[休|やす]みました。
cards.en: I missed school because of illness.
cards.why: A noun giving the cause takes で.

cards.en: The house was damaged in the earthquake.
cards.why: Disasters and accidents as causes take で.

cards.en: It's 1,000 yen in total.
cards.why: 全部で means 'in total'.

cards.en: It's a desk made of wood.
cards.why: A visible material something is made of takes で.

cards.after: [一番|いちばん][高|たか]い[山|やま]は[富士山|ふじさん]です。
cards.en: The highest mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.
cards.why: The range for 一番 takes で.

cards.after: [晩|ばん]ご[飯|はん]を[食|た]べました。
cards.en: I had dinner at a restaurant.
cards.why: Eating is an action, so the place takes で.

cards.after: [旅行|りょこう]に[行|い]きました。
cards.en: I went on a trip by myself.
cards.why: 一人で means 'alone, by oneself'.

groups.title: And; together with; quotation; same / different

uses.label: And (full list)
uses.note: Joins nouns when the list is complete.
uses.example: パンと[卵|たまご]を[買|か]いました。

uses.label: Together with
uses.note: The partner in an action: 話す・結婚する・けんかする.
uses.example: [友達|ともだち]と[話|はな]します。

uses.label: Quotation
uses.note: What someone says or thinks: と言う・と思う.
uses.example: [明日|あした]は[雨|あめ]が[降|ふ]ると[思|おも]います。

uses.label: Same / different
uses.note: The thing compared with 同じ・違う.
uses.example: [私|わたし]のかばんと[同|おな]じです。

cards.before: [昼休|ひるやす]みに[友達|ともだち]
cards.en: I talked with a friend at lunch break.
cards.why: The person you talk with takes と.

cards.en: I bought bread and eggs.
cards.why: と joins nouns into a complete list.

cards.before: [兄|あに]は[去年|きょねん]、[同|おな]じ[会社|かいしゃ]の[人|ひと]
cards.en: Last year my brother married someone from his company.
cards.why: 結婚する marks the partner with と.

cards.en: My mother said, "Be careful."
cards.why: A quotation before 言う takes と.

cards.before: [明日|あした]は[雨|あめ]が[降|ふ]る
cards.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
cards.why: What you think comes before と思う.

cards.before: [私|わたし]のかばんは[姉|あね]のかばん
cards.en: My bag is the same as my sister's.
cards.why: 同じ marks what it is the same as with と.

cards.before: [日本|にほん]の[文化|ぶんか]は[私|わたし]の[国|くに]
cards.en: Japanese culture is different from my country's.
cards.why: 違う marks what it differs from with と.

cards.en: I had a fight with my little brother yesterday.
cards.why: けんかする marks the other person with と.

cards.en: I have a dog and a cat at home.
cards.why: と lists exactly the animals there are.

cards.before: [週末|しゅうまつ]、[私|わたし]は[彼女|かのじょ]
cards.after: [映画|えいが]を[見|み]に[行|い]きました。
cards.en: I went to see a movie with my girlfriend this weekend.
cards.why: The person you do something with takes と.

cards.en: I'd like the same thing as this, please.
cards.why: Xと同じ means 'the same as X'.

cards.before: この[花|はな]は[日本語|にほんご]で「さくら」
cards.en: This flower is called "sakura" in Japanese.
cards.why: A name before 言う takes と: 〜と言います.

cards.after: [一緒|いっしょ]に[住|す]んでいます。
cards.en: I live together with my family.
cards.why: と一緒に marks who you do something with.

groups.title: Also; not … either; nothing / nobody; emphasis on amount

uses.label: Also / too
uses.note: Replaces は・が・を to add 'also'.
uses.example: [山田|やまだ]さんも[学生|がくせい]です。

uses.label: Not … either
uses.note: With a negative verb: 'not X either'.
uses.example: [魚|さかな]も[食|た]べません。

uses.label: Question word + も + negative
uses.note: 何も・だれも・どこにも = nothing, nobody, nowhere.
uses.example: [教室|きょうしつ]にはだれもいません。

uses.label: Emphasis on amount
uses.note: Number + も stresses 'as much / many as'.
uses.example: [三時間|さんじかん]も[勉強|べんきょう]しました。

cards.before: [田中|たなか]さんは[学生|がくせい]です。[山田|やまだ]さん
cards.en: Mr. Tanaka is a student. Mr. Yamada is a student too.
cards.why: Same statement about a second person: も (also).

cards.before: [私|わたし]はコーヒーが[好|す]きです。[紅茶|こうちゃ]
cards.en: I like coffee. I like tea too.
cards.why: も replaces が to add another liked thing.

cards.en: I didn't eat anything this morning.
cards.why: 何も + negative means 'nothing'.

cards.en: There is nobody in the classroom.
cards.why: だれも + negative means 'nobody'.

cards.before: [日曜日|にちようび]はどこに
cards.en: I didn't go anywhere on Sunday.
cards.why: どこにも + negative means 'nowhere'; も follows に.

cards.before: [昨日|きのう]は[三時間|さんじかん]
cards.en: I studied for as long as three hours yesterday.
cards.why: Number + も stresses that the amount is large.

cards.before: [兄|あに]は[肉|にく]を[食|た]べません。[魚|さかな]
cards.en: My brother doesn't eat meat. He doesn't eat fish either.
cards.why: With a negative, も means 'not … either'.

cards.before: [父|ちち]は[英語|えいご]も[中国語|ちゅうごくご]
cards.en: My father can speak both English and Chinese.
cards.why: AもBも means 'both A and B'.

cards.before: [冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ]に[何|なに]
cards.en: There is nothing in the fridge.
cards.why: 何も + ない means 'nothing'.

cards.before: A：[明日|あした]、[海|うみ]に[行|い]きます。B：[私|わたし]
cards.en: A: I'm going to the beach tomorrow. B: I want to go too.
cards.why: Adding yourself to what someone said: 私も.

cards.before: この[本|ほん]は[二回|にかい]
cards.en: I read this book twice (no less).
cards.why: Number + も emphasizes how many times.

cards.en: Please don't tell anyone about this.
cards.why: 誰にも + negative means 'to nobody'.

groups.title: Possession; noun + noun; subject in a modifying clause; nominalizer

uses.label: Possession
uses.note: Whose something is.
uses.example: これは[私|わたし]の[本|ほん]です。

uses.label: Noun + noun
uses.note: Type, origin, position: 日本語の先生, 机の上.
uses.example: [机|つくえ]の[上|うえ]に[本|ほん]があります。

uses.label: Subject in a modifying clause
uses.note: Inside a clause before a noun, が can become の.
uses.example: [母|はは]の[作|つく]ったケーキです。

uses.label: Nominalizer / 'one'
uses.note: Turns a verb into a noun (〜のが好き) or means 'one'.
uses.example: [絵|え]を[描|か]くのが[好|す]きです。

cards.en: This is my book.
cards.why: Possession: person + の + thing.

cards.after: [先生|せんせい]は[優|やさ]しいです。
cards.en: The Japanese teacher is kind.
cards.why: の links two nouns: teacher of Japanese.

cards.en: I went to my friend's house.
cards.why: Whose house: 友達の家.

cards.en: This is a cake my mother made.
cards.why: In a clause before a noun, the subject can take の.

cards.en: I like drawing pictures.
cards.why: の turns the verb 描く into a noun before が好き.

cards.en: Whose umbrella is this?
cards.why: だれの = whose; the noun after it is dropped.

cards.before: この[靴|くつ]は[小|ちい]さいです。もっと[大|おお]きい
cards.en: These shoes are small. Do you have bigger ones?
cards.why: の after an adjective means 'one'.

cards.after: [上|うえ]に[本|ほん]があります。
cards.en: There is a book on the desk.
cards.why: Position words attach with の: 机の上.

cards.after: [車|くるま]は[人気|にんき]があります。
cards.en: Japanese cars are popular.
cards.why: Origin before a noun: 日本の車.

cards.after: [大学|だいがく]で[勉強|べんきょう]しています。
cards.en: I study at a university in Tokyo.
cards.why: Place + の + noun describes where it is.

cards.en: I'm waiting in front of the station.
cards.why: 前・後ろ・近く attach to a noun with の.

cards.en: Listening to music is fun.
cards.why: の makes 聞く into a noun that can take は.

cards.after: お[兄|にい]さんは[医者|いしゃ]です。
cards.en: Mr. Tanaka's older brother is a doctor.
cards.why: Family of someone: person + の.

uses.label: Starting point
uses.note: Where or when something starts.
uses.example: [家|いえ]から[駅|えき]まで[十分|じゅっぷん]です。

uses.label: Source
uses.note: Who or where something comes from; material.
uses.example: [友達|ともだち]から[手紙|てがみ]をもらいました。

uses.label: Reason
uses.note: Sentence + から = because.
uses.example: [暑|あつ]いから[窓|まど]を[開|あ]けます。

uses.label: After doing
uses.note: て-form + から = after doing.
uses.example: [手|て]を[洗|あら]ってから[食|た]べます。

cards.before: [授業|じゅぎょう]は[月曜日|げつようび]
cards.en: Classes start from Monday.
cards.why: The start of a period takes から.

cards.after: [駅|えき]まで[歩|ある]いて[十分|じゅっぷん]です。
cards.en: It's ten minutes on foot from my house to the station.
cards.why: A starting place pairs with まで: AからBまで.

cards.after: [手紙|てがみ]をもらいました。
cards.en: I received a letter from a friend.
cards.why: The giver with もらう takes から.

cards.en: I came from Japan.
cards.why: The place you come from takes から.

cards.en: It's hot, so I'll open the window.
cards.why: から after a sentence gives the reason.

cards.before: [明日|あした]は[休|やす]みです
cards.en: Tomorrow is a day off, so I'll sleep late.
cards.why: です + から gives the reason in polite speech.

cards.before: [日本|にほん]のお[酒|さけ]は[米|こめ]
cards.en: Japanese sake is made from rice.
cards.why: A raw material that changes form takes から.

cards.after: [富士山|ふじさん]が[見|み]えます。
cards.en: You can see Mt. Fuji from the window.
cards.why: The point you look out from takes から.

cards.en: I got a phone call from my mother yesterday.
cards.why: The person a call comes from takes から.

cards.after: ご[飯|はん]を[食|た]べます。
cards.en: I eat after washing my hands.
cards.why: て-form + から means 'after doing'.

cards.en: Summer vacation starts next week.
cards.why: The start point of a period takes から.

cards.en: The meeting is from two to four.
cards.why: AからBまで gives a time range.

groups.title: Until; as far as; by (までに); even

uses.label: Until (time)
uses.note: The time an action continues up to.
uses.example: [五時|ごじ]まで[働|はたら]きます。

uses.label: As far as (place)
uses.note: The end point of movement.
uses.example: [駅|えき]まで[歩|ある]きます。

uses.label: By (deadline)
uses.note: までに = no later than; for one-time actions.
uses.example: [金曜日|きんようび]までに[出|だ]してください。

uses.label: Even
uses.note: Adds a surprising extreme (N4).
uses.example: [子供|こども]まで[知|し]っています。

cards.en: I work until five every day.
cards.why: An action that continues up to a time takes まで.

cards.en: I walk to the station.
cards.why: The end point of the route takes まで.

cards.before: [東京|とうきょう]から[大阪|おおさか]
cards.after: [新幹線|しんかんせん]で[行|い]きます。
cards.en: I go from Tokyo to Osaka by Shinkansen.
cards.why: AからBまで: from A as far as B.

cards.after: レポートを[出|だ]してください。
cards.en: Please submit the report by Friday.
cards.why: A one-time action with a deadline takes までに, not まで.

cards.en: I studied until late at night.
cards.why: Studying continues up to a time: まで.

cards.en: Let's wait until the rain stops.
cards.why: Waiting continues until an event: verb + まで.

cards.en: Please come back by ten.
cards.why: Coming back happens once, so the deadline takes までに.

cards.en: I'll keep trying until the end.
cards.why: Effort that lasts to the end takes まで.

cards.before: その[歌|うた]は[小|ちい]さい[子供|こども]
cards.en: Even small children know that song.
cards.why: まで can mean 'even', adding an extreme case.

cards.before: この[店|みせ]は[何時|なんじ]
cards.en: Until what time is this shop open?
cards.why: Being open is a continuing state, so it takes まで.

cards.en: I'll drive you to the airport.
cards.why: 送る (take someone) marks how far you go with まで.

cards.before: この[本|ほん]は[明日|あした]
cards.en: I'll return this book by tomorrow.
cards.why: Returning is a one-time action, so the deadline takes までに.

groups.title: Partial list: A, B and so on

uses.label: Partial list
uses.note: Gives examples; there are other things too.
uses.example: [本|ほん]やノートがあります。

uses.label: や … など
uses.note: Often finished with など (etc.).
uses.example: りんごやみかんなどを[買|か]いました。

cards.before: [机|つくえ]の[上|うえ]に[本|ほん]
cards.en: There are books, notebooks and so on on the desk.
cards.why: や lists examples, implying there are other things too.

cards.before: [週末|しゅうまつ]は[掃除|そうじ]
cards.en: On weekends I do cleaning, laundry and such.
cards.why: や joins example activities in a list.

cards.before: [夏休|なつやす]みに[京都|きょうと]
cards.en: During summer vacation I went to Kyoto, Nara and other places.
cards.why: や lists some of the places you visited.

cards.after: みかんなどを[買|か]いました。
cards.en: I bought apples, mandarins and so on.
cards.why: や often pairs with など at the end of the list.

cards.after: [猫|ねこ]などの[動物|どうぶつ]が[好|す]きです。
cards.en: I like animals such as dogs and cats.
cards.why: AやBなどの + noun means 'nouns such as A and B'.

cards.en: I put meat, vegetables and so on into the pot.
cards.why: や joins nouns as examples of what goes in.

cards.after: [英語|えいご]を[勉強|べんきょう]しています。
cards.en: I'm studying Japanese, English and so on.
cards.why: や lists example subjects you study.

cards.before: [駅|えき]の[近|ちか]くにはスーパー
cards.en: Near the station there are supermarkets, banks and so on.
cards.why: や lists some of what is there.

cards.before: [休|やす]みの[日|ひ]は[映画|えいが]
cards.after: [買|か]い[物|もの]に[行|い]きます。
cards.en: On days off I go to movies, shopping and so on.
cards.why: や joins example activities.

cards.after: お[皿|さら]を[並|なら]べます。
cards.en: I set out cups, plates and so on on the table.
cards.why: や lists example items being set out.

cards.after: [雪|ゆき]の[日|ひ]は[電車|でんしゃ]で[行|い]きます。
cards.en: On rainy or snowy days I go by train.
cards.why: や joins example kinds of weather before の.

cards.after: [消|け]しゴムが[入|はい]っています。
cards.en: There are pens, erasers and so on in the pencil case.
cards.why: や lists some of the things inside.

cards.after: [卵|たまご]などを[食|た]べます。
cards.en: In the morning I eat bread, eggs and so on.
cards.why: や … など gives typical examples.

uses.label: A は B より
uses.note: B is the standard you compare against.
uses.example: [電車|でんしゃ]はバスより[速|はや]いです。

uses.label: B より A のほうが
uses.note: Says A is more … than B.
uses.example: [肉|にく]より[魚|さかな]のほうが[好|す]きです。

uses.label: Than expected / than anyone
uses.note: 思ったより, 誰よりも (N3).
uses.example: [思|おも]ったより[簡単|かんたん]でした。

uses.label: Formal 'from'
uses.note: Written / announcement style for から (N3).
uses.example: [会議|かいぎ]は[三時|さんじ]より[始|はじ]めます。

cards.before: [東京|とうきょう]は[大阪|おおさか]
cards.en: Tokyo is bigger than Osaka.
cards.why: The thing compared against takes より.

cards.en: Trains are faster than buses.
cards.why: AはBより + adjective: A is more … than B.

cards.after: [魚|さかな]のほうが[好|す]きです。
cards.en: I like fish more than meat.
cards.why: Bより Aのほうが: the less-preferred item takes より.

cards.en: Today is colder than yesterday.
cards.why: The standard of comparison takes より.

cards.after: [三|みっ]つ[年上|としうえ]です。
cards.en: My brother is three years older than me.
cards.why: The person compared against takes より.

cards.after: [電車|でんしゃ]のほうが[便利|べんり]です。
cards.en: The train is more convenient than the bus.
cards.why: Bより Aのほうが: B takes より.

cards.en: It was easier than I thought.
cards.why: 思ったより compares with what you expected.

cards.before: [会議|かいぎ]は[午後|ごご][三時|さんじ]
cards.en: The meeting will begin from 3 p.m.
cards.why: In formal notices, より is used like から.

cards.before: [日本|にほん]の[夏|なつ]は[私|わたし]の[国|くに]
cards.en: Summer in Japan is hotter than in my country.
cards.why: The standard of comparison takes より.

cards.en: He comes earlier than anyone.
cards.why: 誰よりも means 'more than anyone'.

cards.after: [背|せ]が[高|たか]くなりました。
cards.en: I've grown taller than last year.
cards.why: The earlier point you compare against takes より.

cards.before: [自転車|じてんしゃ]は[歩|ある]く
cards.en: Cycling is faster than walking.
cards.why: より can follow a verb as the standard of comparison.

groups.title: Question marker; or; embedded questions; some-

uses.label: Question / invitation
uses.note: At the end of a sentence it makes a question or an offer.
uses.example: これは[何|なん]ですか。

uses.label: Or
uses.note: AかB = A or B.
uses.example: [土曜日|どようび]か[日曜日|にちようび]に[行|い]きます。

uses.label: Embedded question
uses.note: A question inside a sentence (N4).
uses.example: [彼|かれ]が[来|く]るかどうか[分|わ]かりません。

uses.label: Some- (indefinite)
uses.note: 何か・だれか・どこか = something, someone, somewhere.
uses.example: [何|なに]か[食|た]べたいです。

cards.en: What is this?
cards.why: か at the end of a polite sentence makes it a question.

cards.before: A：[明日|あした]、[学校|がっこう]に[行|い]きます
cards.en: A: Are you going to school tomorrow? B: Yes, I am.
cards.why: A yes/no question ends in か.

cards.after: [鉛筆|えんぴつ]で[書|か]いてください。
cards.en: Please write in pen or pencil.
cards.why: AかB means 'A or B'.

cards.after: [日曜日|にちようび]に[行|い]きます。
cards.en: I'll go on Saturday or Sunday.
cards.why: か between two nouns gives a choice.

cards.en: I want to eat something.
cards.why: 何か means 'something'.

cards.en: Someone has come to the door.
cards.why: だれか means 'someone'.

cards.after: [静|しず]かな[所|ところ]へ[行|い]きたいです。
cards.en: I want to go somewhere quiet.
cards.why: どこか means 'somewhere'.

cards.after: どうか[分|わ]かりません。
cards.en: I don't know whether he will come.
cards.why: 〜かどうか means 'whether or not'.

cards.before: [会議|かいぎ]が[何時|なんじ]に[始|はじ]まる
cards.en: Do you know what time the meeting starts?
cards.why: A question word + か forms a question inside a sentence.

cards.before: いっしょに[帰|かえ]りません
cards.en: Won't you go home with me?
cards.why: 〜ませんか is a polite invitation.

cards.after: 、[働|はたら]くか、まだ[決|き]めていません。
cards.en: I haven't decided yet whether to go to university or work.
cards.why: 〜か〜か lists the choices you are deciding between.

cards.before: すみません、[駅|えき]はどこです
cards.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
cards.why: A question with どこ ends in か.
